Typical thresholds: pilot commitments under $10k run the fastest for temporary invoice-only approval; above that we usually require a purchase order.

What we need from you to evaluate an exception:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (Drive link below)
- W-9 (US vendors) or local tax form
- Certificate of insurance (general liability)
- A point estimate showing total pilot budget (line items in the SOW)

Thanks for the context, Mina. Ava — welcome.

Procurement process and temporary exception path (summary):
1) Risk intake: we need W-9 (or equivalent), COI (limits: $1M GL preferred), and the completed vendor onboarding form.
2) Exception form: Procurement requires a signed temporary exception (SUP-459) that documents the scope, budget cap, and expiration date for the invoice-only arrangement. I attached the draft exception form for your reference.
3) Finance acknowledgement: Finance (AP) must confirm Net30 is acceptable and will route invoices to the temporary pay path.
4) Duration: exceptions are typically limited to 60 days or until a PO can be issued — whichever comes first.

Please note: we will not start paying until Finance confirms routing; getting the paperwork in this week is essential for the demo on 05/20.

Action items for Ava:
- Return vendor onboarding form + W-9 + COI by Tue 2026-05-12 EOD
- Confirm max pilot spend (budget cap) so we can populate SUP-459
